correctness.rationale: Local-Pauli commutation forces every two-axis qubit into an isolated two-vertex Bell dimer; all other sites are locally Clifford diagonalizable. The four Bell energy sectors and their partial-transpose eigenvalues give exact separability and arbitrary-cut trace-norm formulas. Bell sign triples differ in two coordinates, so all energy gaps are at most \(4J\); the isotropic antiferromagnetic two-qubit Heisenberg witness has exactly \(4J\) gaps and overlap degree two. A complete analytic all-size proof includes degeneracies and endpoints. Verification via the embedded executable yielded 9957 finite commuting-subset structural checks, 6600 direct PPT checks and 3960 cut checks; all such computations are corroborative rather than proofs of infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The first possible three-term commuting overlap cluster sharply changes the universal coefficient-normalized separability frontier while excluding noncommuting and high-locality effects. Its sharp many-body, system-size-free bound is a natural localized answer to the recent unrestricted-locality thermal question. The full finite-temperature classification and additive exact negativity across every cut supplies physically interpretable quantitative content beyond a simple two-qubit threshold and extends to arbitrary classical diagonal interactions among remaining spins.
